verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant operate the platform directly, with documented example natural-language queries like "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?" and lets the assistant list audits, evidence requests, and add comments/status updates. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's real-world reliability and a broader range of documented natural-language commands beyond the audit/evidence use case.
